# Grace & Perry

- [Grace](../character/grace.md) — Enemy of — [Perry](../character/perry.md) — hostility towards him for eating her pet rooster and lecturing her · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P7](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0007)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) joins [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Bess](../character/bess-carrow.md), and [Izzy](../character/izzy.md) in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) to chew spruce gum. [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) feels envious of Mary's fine new clothes and muff, while Mary brings news of local gossip and mentions that [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) killed a rooster for dinner. Horrified that their pet rooster [Adam](../character/adam.md) has been killed, [Grace](../character/grace.md) rushes home, prompting [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) to repentantly give Mary her gum and compliment her muff.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS

> After being teased at school about the loss of her rooster [Adam](../character/adam.md), [Grace](../character/grace.md) goes toward [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) seeking comfort from Mrs. [Carrow](../character/carrow.md). In [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), she meets [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), who listens sympathetically to Grace's grief and offers her a pet canary. [Grace](../character/grace.md) returns home feeling comforted and tells her father and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) how much she loves [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md).
